nodes.question: What percentage of Africa's labor force is employed in agriculture?
nodes.answer: About 65% of Africa's labor force is employed in agriculture.

nodes.question: What unemployment rate was reported by the National Bureau of Statistics in 2021?
nodes.paragraph: In addition to the SAM, we rely on methodologies and data from the Food and Agri - culture Organisation (FAO) for calculating indicators for food security, focusing on three dimensions: food availability, access to food, and vulnerability of supplies (FAO, 2006 ). Also, we use unemployment data from the National Bureau of Statistics ( 2021 ) which indi - cated an unemployment rate of 33.3%. Next, we set the elasticity of real wages with respect to unemployment ( ) at -0.1, which is a standard value in the literature on wage curves and has been applied in countries like South Africa (Blanchflower and Oswald 1995 ; Kingdom & Knight, 2004). As for the elasticities, we use the elasticities of Nigeria taken from the GTAP 10 database (Aguiar et al. 2019 ) and carry out sensitivity tests from the elasticities of Burkina Faso (Zidouemba et al., 2015 ), a country in the same economic area as Nigeria. Concerning the conception of the climate scenario, we rely on historical data of disasters recorded in the EMDAT database for Nigeria and microeconomic data obtained from the Nigeria Liv - ing Standards Survey 2018 2019 (Wave 4) produced by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS).
